survey: A round wall clock seen almost straight-on, hanging flat against a green striped wall. It has a thick orange rim shaped like a tube, a flat white face inside it, 12 navy hour bars and a ring of small minute dots, and a navy hour hand, navy minute hand and thin red second hand, all pinned to a central navy-and-red cap. The rim and face are near-perfect circles that share a centre (about 805 by 800 px in the enlarged view), which fits a face pointing at the camera. The rim is about the same thickness all the way round. The hour bars and dots are evenly spaced, point out from the centre and are all the same size, which is right for a flat face seen front-on. The hands all start at the central cap. The clock casts a soft shadow onto the wall to the lower right, so it sits flat against a wall that is also drawn front-on. The camera is the same for the clock and the wall.
